text:
QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND` and `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_MEMSAN` (`mbedtls_config.h:2109-2142`) make selected tests also check the constant-flow property. Per the header comments, this uses valgrind memcheck or clang MemorySanitizer.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names the opt-in valgrind/MemSan test options, but it never says the facility is separate from the library API (it is not part of the library API), so half of the item is absent.
